name: confirm
description: Ask the person to approve something before it happens. Show the summary with a yes and a no (or the labels given), and room to say something else. Reply confirmed=true only on an explicit yes; put anything else they said in note.

approve.description: The yes button's label, naming the action (e.g. Send); Yes when left out

decline.description: The no button's label (e.g. Don't Send); No when left out

summary.description: What is about to happen, for the person to approve

note.description: Anything the person said instead, e.g. a different amount
